description: pypowsybl, published by powsybl, exposes the Java PowSyBl framework to Python through a GraalVM native library, including load-flow calculations and network-data access. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MPL-2.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: It provides a separate Python integration with platform-powsybl; that record describes the Java core without naming this package.
